INTERVIEWER: Please state your name for the record.
DEFENDANT: Isabella Moreno.
INTERVIEWER: Where were you on the evening of September 21st?
DEFENDANT: I was at my sister's house. I didn't go to the market.
INTERVIEWER: Have you had prior run-ins with the law?
DEFENDANT: I had something a long time ago.
[PAUSE]
INTERVIEWER: Prior convictions: Shoplifting (2016), Drug possession (2014).
DEFENDANT: That was ages ago; it shouldn't matter.
INTERVIEWER: Thank you. That concludes the recorded portion.
[end of recording]
